headline: Jets sign defenceman Logan Stanley to a one-year contract
title: Jets sign defenceman Logan Stanley to a one-year contract
summary: WINNIPEG- The Winnipeg Jets announced today they have agreed to terms with defenceman Logan Stanley on a one-year contract with an average annual value of $1,000,000.
body:
**WINNIPEG**- The Winnipeg Jets announced today they have agreed to terms with defenceman <forge-entity title="Logan Stanley" slug="logan-stanley-8479378" code="player">Logan Stanley</forge-entity> on a one-year contract with an average annual value of $1,000,000.

Stanley, 25, played 19 games for the Jets in 2022-23 and recorded three points (1G, 2A) and 21 penalty minutes. The Waterloo, Ont. native also played in one playoff game for Winnipeg. Stanley, the Jets' first-round pick (18th overall) in the 2016 NHL Draft, has played 114 career NHL games for Winnipeg and posted 20 points (3G, 17A) and 91 PIMs.
